questions.question: The Earth is flat.
questions.explanation: The Earth is approximately spherical in shape, not flat.

questions.question: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at standard atmospheric pressure (sea level).

questions.question: The sun revolves around the Earth.
questions.explanation: The Earth revolves around the sun, not the other way around.
